scenes.beat: Dawn, same grip. Across the water a flashlight flashes SOS from a roof. He knows the code (his coast-watch card).
A wooden door drifts by below. He lets go and drops onto it.
Paddling by hand across the drowned city. The current pulls him seaward; a floating car spins past.
Mia on the roof in a yellow raincoat: flashlight and crank radio. She says her name and who taught her the code.
The crank radio: tsunami warning. Second wave in twenty minutes, bigger. The clock starts.
The first wave's wet line reaches her roof's edge. Across the water: the harbor tower, fourteen floors.
The sea starts draining out of the streets: the sign the next wave is coming. 15:00 left.
